measurement.timing_scope: Policy elapsed includes its own candidate scan/prediction/order, stable moves, handle updates, trailing munmap and candidate release. Setup, common quota scan, integrity checks and RSS observations are separate.
measurement.detail_timing_scope: No per-segment clock calls. FIFO/none decision and movement/reclaim subphase timings are null; ranked decision uses one stage timestamp.
measurement.conditioning_scope: Optional separate cache-line-write buffer allocated/touched after pre-checksum, excluded from policy time and held through both RSS snapshots. Shared conditioning is not application data and does not guarantee cold caches.
measurement.memory_scope: Mapped byte release is exact address-space accounting; current RSS is observed separately and may differ. Peak RSS is process lifetime including setup.
measurement.layout_scope: Actual compressed records, repeated only via explicit copies; synthetic deletions. 16-byte aligned records; initially unused whole pages and entirely empty segments released during common setup.
measurement.integrity_scope: FNV-1a over stable handle ID, compressed length and every surviving payload byte before/after; noncryptographic error detector; no decompression or kernel integration.
